direction: Regime-adaptive dual-hook LNS: make `score_ruin_nodes` cost-per-iteration aware and `score_recreate_action` regime-conditioned so that large-n (size=100), uniform-spatial, eccentric-depot, loose-capacity instances get geometric/angular-cluster ruin with cheaper per-node scoring, while small-n instances get aggressive worst-cost removal.

operations.mechanism: Archive shows a saturated portfolio (SBS 16.1100, VBS 15.3838 total / gap 0.21%) across three near-identical L3b solvers, so marginal gains must come from the regime where the frontier is weakest: size=100 (12/12 exhausted), uniform spatial, eccentric depot, uniform demand, loose capacity — i.e. cases where the 500 ms deadline caps LNS iterations. KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 documents that the L3 skeleton's bottleneck at tight budgets is per-iteration ruin+regret-2 cost (25 ms => 120/120 early stop) and that the evolvable hook is exactly `score_ruin_nodes`; combined with method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret (Shaw relatedness vs worst vs random destroy trade-off) and method-cvrp-cheapest-regret-insertion (regret-2 vs cheapest detour), the plan is to co-evolve both hooks under a stagnation/iter_frac-driven schedule that trades expensive relatedness for cheap geometric ruin at large n. This is causally testable per-instance on dev_24 (iteration-count delta on size=100 vs objective delta) and preserves the frozen interface (dual-hook template, postprocess none) so 5-gate validation is unchanged.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: Because all size=100 and uniform-spatial/eccentric-depot/loose-capacity regimes show exhausted_instances (LNS iterations truncated by the 500 ms deadline) and their vbs_rel_gap_pct is ~-20%, the binding constraint is iteration throughput at large n, not local-optimum quality. A ruin score that (a) scales the rank-power exponent with iter_frac and stagnation_ratio, (b) down-weights per-node evaluation cost via a distance-gated coarse candidate set (O(n) instead of O(n^2) relatedness), and (c) makes the recreate hook prefer geometrically coherent (angular-sector / heavy-load) insertions rather than pure detour-minimum, will increase completed LNS iterations per 500 ms on size=100 instances and thus lower mean objective vs the current SBS 16.1100 without regressing n<=64 cases.
